business: Gobblo Plus: the one-time upgrade inside Gobblo, a free iPhone app where a cute pet eats your to-do list (made for ADHD brains)
target: iPhone users, 16 to 30, with ADHD or ADHD traits, who already use the free Gobblo app and struggle to start tasks
where: US, UK, Canada and Europe, App Store

behaviours.name: Collector
behaviours.how: Loves unlocking cute things; already has Finch and pays for cosmetics in games.

behaviours.name: Burned by subscriptions
behaviours.how: Forgot to cancel a free trial once; now refuses anything with a trial or a subscription.

behaviours.name: Free-forever user
behaviours.how: Almost never pays for apps; uses the free version until it stops working.

behaviours.name: Tried every ADHD app
behaviours.how: Has downloaded Tiimo, Structured, Goblin Tools; abandons apps after two weeks.

behaviours.name: Sharer
behaviours.how: Posts aesthetic screenshots and recaps on TikTok and Instagram stories.

behaviours.name: Tool optimiser
behaviours.how: Pays happily for anything that clearly saves time; hates fluff.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Checks App Store reviews and Reddit before paying for anything.

objections: I'll probably stop using the app in two weeks, like every other one
Is this just cosmetics? The free app already works
Will they switch me to a subscription later, like Goblin Tools did?
Money is tight; apps should be free
I don't want more things to manage, I want fewer
habits: you have 40 tabs open in your head and three to-do apps you don't use
you leave things until the last minute, then hyperfocus at night
you have a lock screen with widgets
you follow ADHD creators on TikTok
